title: Optimizing Long-Term Compliance Data Retention
business: Legal and financial firms requiring multi-year retention of closed case files.
problem: High monthly storage costs for massive volumes of inactive, legacy case data that is rarely accessed but must be kept for regulatory compliance.
solution: Azure Blob Archive Tier provides a cost-effective storage solution for data that is not needed for immediate operations, keeping it in an offline state until explicitly requested.
steps: Identify inactive blobs that meet the criteria for long-term retention.
Apply a lifecycle management policy or manual update to move the target blobs to the Archive access tier.
Initiate a rehydration process when access to the archived data is required for an audit.
Wait for the rehydration process to complete, which changes the blob tier to Hot or Cool.
Access the rehydrated blob data as standard storage once the process finishes.
outcome: Significant reduction in monthly storage expenditures while maintaining the ability to retrieve historical records for compliance audits.
limitation: The primary trade-off is latency; archived data is offline and cannot be read immediately, requiring a rehydration process that takes time to complete before the data becomes available.
